properties.text: Trie node must be None, LeafNode, ExtensionNode, or BranchNode; all other types must be rejected.
properties.assertion: forall node in trie: type(node) in {None, LeafNode, ExtensionNode, BranchNode} || raise AssertionError

properties.text: RLP-encoded nodes under 32 bytes return unencoded form; nodes >= 32 bytes return keccak256 hash.
properties.assertion: forall node: (len(rlp.encode(node)) < 32 => return unencoded) && (len(rlp.encode(node)) >= 32 => return keccak256(encoded))

properties.text: Account nodes must have non-None storage_root before encoding.
properties.assertion: forall node: isinstance(node, Account) => storage_root is not None

properties.text: Unrecognized node types must fall back to previous_trie.encode_node, preserving cross-fork compatibility.
properties.assertion: forall node: type(node) not in {Account, LegacyTx, Receipt, Withdrawal, U256, Bytes} => previous_trie.encode_node(node)

properties.text: copy_trie must produce a shallow copy of _data so mutations to copy do not affect original trie.
properties.assertion: forall trie t: copy = copy_trie(t) => (copy._data is not t._data) && (forall k: copy._data[k] is t._data[k])

properties.text: Setting a key to the default value must delete it from trie._data, not store the default.
properties.assertion: forall trie t, key k: trie_set(t, k, t.default) => k not in t._data

properties.text: trie_get must return trie.default for absent keys, never raise or return None.
properties.assertion: forall trie t, key k: k not in t._data => trie_get(t, k) == t.default

properties.text: common_prefix_length return value must be in [0, min(len(a), len(b))].
properties.assertion: forall a, b: 0 <= common_prefix_length(a, b) <= min(len(a), len(b))

properties.text: All characters up to common_prefix_length index must be identical between the two sequences.
properties.assertion: forall a, b: let n = common_prefix_length(a, b) => forall j < n: a[j] == b[j]

properties.text: All nibble values in nibble list input must be in range [0, 15].
properties.assertion: forall x: forall nibble in x: 0 <= nibble <= 15

properties.text: High nibble of compact encoding's first byte must correctly encode is_leaf flag and parity.
properties.assertion: forall x, is_leaf: compact[0] >> 4 == (2*is_leaf + (len(x) % 2))

properties.text: Compact encoding output length must equal ceil((len(x) + 1) / 2).
properties.assertion: forall x: len(nibble_list_to_compact(x)) == ceil((len(x) + 1) / 2)

properties.text: bytes_to_nibble_list output length must be exactly 2 * input length.
properties.assertion: forall bytes_: len(bytes_to_nibble_list(bytes_)) == 2 * len(bytes_)

properties.text: Each output nibble of bytes_to_nibble_list must be in range [0, 15].
properties.assertion: forall bytes_: forall n in bytes_to_nibble_list(bytes_): 0 <= n <= 15

properties.text: bytes_to_nibble_list and nibble_list_to_compact must be inverses (modulo compact header byte).
properties.assertion: forall b: decode_compact(nibble_list_to_compact(bytes_to_nibble_list(b), false)) == bytes_to_nibble_list(b)

properties.text: All encoded values in _prepare_trie output must be non-empty; empty encoding causes assertion failure.
properties.assertion: forall trie t: forall v in _prepare_trie(t): v != b''

properties.text: Secured tries must hash keys with keccak256 before nibble conversion; unsecured tries use raw keys.
properties.assertion: forall trie t, key k: t.secured => mapped_key == bytes_to_nibble_list(keccak256(k))

properties.text: Account values in _prepare_trie require a non-None get_storage_root callback.
properties.assertion: forall trie t: (exists v in t._data: isinstance(v, Account)) => get_storage_root is not None

properties.text: Empty trie must return EMPTY_TRIE_ROOT (keccak256 of RLP-encoded empty byte string).
properties.assertion: forall trie t: len(t._data) == 0 => root(t) == keccak256(rlp.encode(b''))

properties.text: Trie root must always be exactly 32 bytes.
properties.assertion: forall trie t: len(root(t)) == 32

properties.text: Empty patricialize input must return None; single-element input must return LeafNode.
properties.assertion: forall obj: (len(obj) == 0 => patricialize(obj) == None) && (len(obj) == 1 => isinstance(patricialize(obj), LeafNode))

properties.text: Account, Receipt, and Uint must not appear at branch value positions in patricialize.
properties.assertion: forall BranchNode b: not isinstance(b.value, (Account, Receipt, Uint))

properties.text: Recursive patricialize calls must strictly increase level parameter, ensuring termination.
properties.assertion: forall recursive call patricialize(obj, level'): level' > level

properties.text: Before trie_set, the value argument must be validated against expected type for the trie.
properties.assertion: forall trie_set(t, k, v): type(v) in t.expected_value_types || v == t.default

properties.text: After trie_set(t, k, v) with v != default, trie_get(t, k) must return v.
properties.assertion: forall trie_set(t, k, v): v != t.default => trie_get(t, k) == v

properties.text: After trie_set(t, k, default), trie_get(t, k) must return default.
properties.assertion: forall trie_set(t, k, t.default): trie_get(t, k) == t.default

properties.text: After root() computation, result must be deterministic: same trie._data produces same root.
properties.assertion: forall trie t1, t2: t1._data == t2._data => root(t1) == root(t2)

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all trie data derived from P2P input must be fully validated before insertion.
properties.assertion: forall data from P2P: validated(data) == true before trie_set(trie, key, data)

properties.text: Engine API (EL-CL) is JWT-authenticated; data from EL may lack full verification by CL.
properties.assertion: forall engine_api_call: jwt_authenticated(call) == true && data_integrity_verified(call.response) == partial

properties.text: get_storage_root callback must return valid storage roots; corrupted roots propagate to state root.
properties.assertion: forall get_storage_root(addr): len(result) == 32 && result == keccak256(rlp.encode(storage_trie(addr)))

properties.text: previous_trie.encode_node must produce encoding compatible with current fork's trie structure.
properties.assertion: forall node: previous_trie.encode_node(node).is_valid_in(current_fork_trie) == true

properties.text: Trie root computation via any code path (constructor, deserializer, copy) must yield identical root for identical data.
properties.assertion: forall construction_path p1, p2: data(p1) == data(p2) => root(trie(p1)) == root(trie(p2))

properties.text: Cached or precomputed trie roots must match freshly computed roots for the same trie state.
properties.assertion: forall trie t: cached_root(t) == root(t)

properties.text: After Osaka fork activation, trie encoding must use Osaka rules; pre-Osaka encoding must not be applied.
properties.assertion: forall block b: b.fork == Osaka => trie_encode(b) uses osaka_trie.encode_node

properties.text: Patricialize must produce correct ExtensionNode when all keys share a common prefix of length > 0.
properties.assertion: forall obj: shared_prefix(obj, level) > 0 => isinstance(patricialize(obj, level), ExtensionNode)

properties.text: BranchNode must have exactly 16 subnodes; missing or extra subnodes indicate structural corruption.
properties.assertion: forall BranchNode b: len(b.subnodes) == 16

properties.text: Before root() computation, _prepare_trie must complete without assertion errors for all entries.
properties.assertion: forall trie t: _prepare_trie(t, get_storage_root) completes without AssertionError

properties.text: After fork transition, derived trie caches from previous fork must be invalidated before new operations.
properties.assertion: forall fork_transition(old, new): trie_cache(old).invalidated == true before trie_op(new)
